description: The interpreter's operand builder materializes a Utf8Binary prepared key through fz_alloc_bitstring_const (one process-heap allocation) and then falls through to dispatch_const_to_value, whose own Utf8Binary arm builds the same value byte by byte through utf8_binary_const_value (src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs). One constant, two constructors, and they are not allocation-equivalent: guard_plan_inputs.fz pins bitstring_allocs at exactly 1 across a receive. Fold to one constructor and let the fixture's pin say which; if the two must differ, the difference is a fact to state where the second constructor lives.
title: A binary dispatch constant is built two ways
